summary: Q32 Bio furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a press release and clinical data, not a special situation. The company reported 36-week results and initial 16-week off-drug follow-up from Part B of the SIGNAL-AA Phase 2a open-label trial of bempikibart in 33 severe or very severe alopecia areata patients, with baseline SALT scores of 50-100 and a maximum current-episode duration of four years; 36.4% had prior oral JAK inhibitor exposure. Data were presented at the EADV Congress 2026. Watch efficacy durability and safety ahead of any later-stage development or financing decision.
